title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI Astra Solves 10 Math Problems: Greg Brockman shared that OpenAI's next major model family, Astra, solved 10 long-standing open problems across mathematics and quantum complexity.
Unitree Debuts AS2-W Super Athlete: Unitree Robotics introduced its AS2-W humanoid system, demonstrating continuous 16kg payload support and a 30+ km driving range.
DOE Partners with Arcee.ai on Open Science AI: Arcee.ai announced a partnership with the US Department of Energy to develop Genesis-Science-1, an open foundation model for scientific research.
James Comey Files Motion to Dismiss Charges: Former FBI Director James Comey filed a legal motion seeking dismissal of social media-related charges on First Amendment grounds.
Jude Bellingham Honored at Birmingham Match: Jude Bellingham attended the Birmingham vs. Barcelona fixture following confirmation of his playmaker #10 role in José Mourinho's tactical system.
